meta.parties: Weerasinghe v. Ran Banda and Two Others

rules.statement: For adoption under the old Kandyan Law before Ordinance No. 39 of 1938, it was necessary that the parties be of the same caste, the adoption should be public and formally declared, and it must clearly appear that the adoption was for the purpose of inheriting the property of the adoptive parents.
rules.supporting_quote: "For the purpose of inheritance, the necessary requisites were: (1) The parties should be of the same caste. (2) The adoption should be public and formally and openly declared and acknowledged. (3) It must also clearly appear that the adoption was for the purpose of inheriting the property of the adoptive parents."
